notes.title: Update v1.01
notes.notes:

A first update for Top Down Racer is online with the following changes:

- New camera movement, which means that you see more of what is in front of your car
- Changed default gamepad settings to more common buttons
- Your setting for the zoom mode will be saved (it wasn't before)
- The start button containing the version number now (see picture below)

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33112350/2d0a5e0c18ee5acfbeb263b6242d3fffa50d277e.png[/img]

Have a great day

Thomas

notes.title: Final Touches - Full Release In A Few Days
notes.notes:
Hello everybody,

It's time for a last Early Access Update because the most work is done and only a few tweaks are left before the full release.

A lot of things have been changed and were added to the game and the most of your suggestions are included.
Here are the largest differences between Early Access and Full Release:

- AI Behaviour (improved weight feeling and drifting)
- Leveling System
- Controller Support
- New Elements/Obstacles (let yourself be surprised)
- High Scores (time rankings for every single track)
- And, of course, a lot more Tracks (60) and Cars (6)


A Screenshot of the control menu with a lot of settings for you:

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33112350/0ab3ff8c73d040405f91abe80fd22ba7d46d2731.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33112350/ed44ab3117cedddd2a2ded6c44e339e786cfebf1.png[/img][/url]
(click for full size)


Ingame screenshot with new terrain:

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33112350/2e0593a3b7e3b89c70961778fcd585af26135d52.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33112350/a2577235044759d61af719772743a260aaa95bbc.png[/img][/url]
(click for full size)

Give me a few more days. The release of the full version will be during the next week.

Have a great weekend!

Thomas

notes.title: New Game Update and More Winners
notes.notes:
Hi everybody,

[b]Two things to talk about: More winners and a new update.[/b]


[h1]We will have more winners![/h1]
[b]Our total number of winners increased to 17[/b] because more than 200 people played the game long enough to win 3 or more medals. Thank you all! :)
For more details about how the contest works and why we have that number of winners, please read these two older News:[list]
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/TopDownRacer/announcements/detail/1681419156920486702]News about the contest[/url]
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/TopDownRacer/announcements/detail/1681419156993402489]News about more winners[/url]
[/list]
And as you know, we may have more winners at the end of the contest. It depends on how many people play the game and will have 3 or more medals total. If you want to help spread the word, here are some links to share:[list]
[*][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/881230]Steam Shop Page[/url]
[*][url=https://www.facebook.com/NeobiteGames]Facebook[/url]
[*][url=https://www.twitter.com/NeobiteGames]Twitter[/url].
[/list]
Thank you. :)

Remember: If we reach 300 players with 3 or more medals total then all winners of the full version of the game will get an additional surprise.



[h1]Todays Game Update[/h1]

A bunch of changes were made to the game and released today. [u]All changes are tested but nevertheless bugs and mistakes happen. So please let me know if you have any strange behaviour or an error in the game.[/u]

[b]List of all changes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Changed description in the Racing Mode (it led to confusion that you first win a bronze medal when you win a race against opponents. That is because you won against some not so fast opponents. If you race again the opponents will be faster and you win silver if you finish as the first. After silver your opponents will be really fast and you will get gold if you win a third time).

[*]Russian language added – [b]Many thanks to the translator: Nickolay Orekhov![/b]

[*]The game now should identify the language you set in the game settings/Steam and change automatically to your setting. Nevertheless there are still buttons in the main menu to change the language.

[*]Screenshot function added – You may use the F12 key or whatever you defined in the Steam settings to make a screenshot.

[*]Some small adjustments to text sizes.

[*]Start button adjustments (it did not appear on some display resolutions).

[*]Added shadows to the cars.

[*]In Racing Mode and while racing the texts „Two Laps To Go“ and „One Lap To Go“ did not fade away correctly. That should be solved.

[*]New Music added. There are different songs playing randomly.

[*]Sounds and Music are seperated. You may turn on and off both independent of each other in the main menu.

[*]Volume buttons added. You may change the volume of sounds and music as you wish. For both, sounds and music a volume bar was added to have the current volume setting visible.

[*]Your sound and music settings will be saved and should be the same when you leave the game and enter it again the next time.

[*]Short jingle added to the start screen.

[*]Small adjustments to the graphics of the scroll buttons in the High Score menu.
[/list]

Thanks for reading and have a nice weekend. :)

notes.title: More Winners & More Work
notes.notes:
Hello everybody,

This News is a bit longer but important things and headings are highlighted. Just jump to what is interesting for you.
The focus will be on two things:

First: Increased number of winners in the contest
Second: Things to change and add to the final version of the game



[h1]Increased number of winners in the contest[/h1]

You know about the contest to win the final version of the game? [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/TopDownRacer/announcements/detail/1681419156920486702]You may read about it here.[/url]

First of all, the important thing: [b]The number of winners increased to 12[/b] and the chances are very good that we will have more than 12 winners.The reasons:[list][*]There was a little bug in the calculations of the game that led to an advantage in the racing times for a handful of people with specific hardware. It's just my fault that some had that advantage, it's not their fault and, of course, it's not the fault of all people who didn't have that advantage. Therefore the number of winners increased by the number of people who had the advantage of the bug. That's 7 by now plus the original 5 = 12.
The bug is fixed and I apologize for the circumstances.
[*]We are close to 17 winners because the rules of the contest says that for every 100 players who have at least 3 medals total we will have 5 winners. [b]We are close to 200 people with 3 medals and if they are reached we will have 17 winners![/b] :)
[/list]
If you would like to help spread the word, here are links to the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/881230]Steam page[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/NeobiteGames]Facebook[/url] and [url=https://www.twitter.com/NeobiteGames]Twitter[/url].



[h1]Things to change and add to the final version of the game[/h1]

There was a lot of feedback and I added all suggestions to my own list and split it into three categories:
[list]
[*] [b]Sure:[/b] I will work on this things before the release of the final verison
[*] [b]Not sure:[/b] things I want to have in the game but not sure if I have enough resources (time, money, knowledge) to add them. They may be in the final version, added afterwards or won't be included.
[*] [b]Won't be included:[/b] what the final version will not be or have[/list]

[b]Sure:[/b][list]
[*] More obstacles
[*] More and larger maps → those available at the moment are only appetizers
[*] More vehicles
[*] Tweaked car handling
[*] Leveling system to unlock cars and maps
[*] Different music and music while racing (with options to turn off sounds and music independent of each other)
[*] Adding screenshot function
[*] Improved feeling and behaviour of the AI cars[/list]

[b]Not sure:[/b][list]
[*] Integrate controller
[*] Objects on the road to smash
[*] Adding current highscore place/time for every single track to the track menu
[*] Power ups → I'm not sure if this fits to the game but I have ideas for similar things that could be a good compromise
[*] Online play → I have no idea if this is realizable with my possibilities but if there is time I will investigate on this
[*] Offline multiplayer → same as above
[*] Platinum medals → low priority because it's not really necessary
[*] More AI (cars) → same as above
[*] Customisation → I'm not sure if the game needs it and I'm not sure if it's realizable with my possibilities[/list]

[b]Won't be included:[/b][list]
[*] Pixel Art → I will tweak the current style but won't change to Pixel Art
[*] Weapons → That's not what I want to have in the game
[/list]

That's it ... or do you have other suggestions or any questions? Just let me know. :)

notes.title: Contest - Win the final version of "Top Down Racer"
notes.notes:
You have the chance to win the final version of the game. All you have to do is drive! Drive fast, get medals and be one of the top 5 (or maybe more - see below) with your high score in the World Championship Records. The contest lasts until midnight between September 25 and September 26, 2018 (Timezone: EDT ~ UTC-4). If you are one of the top 5 at this time you get the final game for free as soon as it is finished.

Additionally the number of winners will increase if more players play the game (all players who have at least 3 medals total count). For every 100 players there will be 5 winners. For example: 200 players = 10 winners while 199 players = 5 winners. If we reach 300 players with 3 or more medals before September 26 there will be an additional surprise/price for all the winners (at that point the top 15).

Please help us to reach a high number of players and winners. You may share the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/881230]shop page[/url] for example, or visit Neobite Games on [url=https://www.facebook.com/NeobiteGames]Facebook[/url] or [url=https://www.twitter.com/NeobiteGames]Twitter[/url] and share the posts about the game.

Thank you and have fun. :)
